blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § One Incident Through the System
blocks.md: A database service triggers a query-latency alert shortly after a configuration change. An automated remediation agent inspects telemetry, correlates logs, and proposes reverting to the previous known-good settings. The human operator approves the rollback, but the configuration endpoint drops the network connection before returning an acknowledgment. Whether the mutation took effect is now unknown, the classic dilemma of a lost acknowledgment in a distributed system, and no fluent explanation from a language model can resolve it.
